Why did `.xlsx` uploads return HTTP `500` and how does SCRIPE Data Exchange harden uploads, OWASP security, and 10-provider flows?

Long image

A

Answer

Cloud R2 credential errors inside .env crashed staging uploads while OwaspSpreadsheetSecurityValidator classified infrastructure errors as parse errors; zero HTTP 500 responses remain.1

  1. ResilientDevelopmentBlobStorage rewinds upload streams and latches all five blob actions to LocalBlobStorage when cloud transport fails in Development.1
  2. SpreadsheetValidationException separates malformed or hostile files (422) from storage outages (503) and sanitizes background ErrorSummary strings.2
  3. DataExchangeOrchestrator enforces fail-closed FLS and cf:* clearance on downloads while IdempotencyBehavior caches safe retries by stream SHA-256.3
  4. All 10 CRM, PartyKernel, and Identity providers align natural keys, batch lookups, and quotas alongside Nexus --nx-* and RTL Studio UX.4

How does the resilient upload pipeline eliminate .xlsx HTTP 500 crashes and retry 409 conflicts?

Diagram structure
  • Studio Client studio
  • Transfer API ctrl
  • Idempotency Gate idem
  • OWASP Validator owasp
  • Resilient Blob blob
  • Local FileHost local
  • studio → ctrl · POST /inspect (.xlsx + Idempotency-Key)
  • ctrl → idem · Buffer Stream & Hash Tenant + Actor + SHA-256
  • idem → owasp · Verify PK Magic, ZIP Ratio, XML & Macros
  • owasp → blob · Stage Verified Workbook Stream
  • blob → local · Rewind Stream & Latch to FileHost on R2 Error
  • local → studio · 200 OK (Sheets, Samples & Cached Envelope)
  1. Transfer API ↗

    Copies non-seekable multipart streams into memory before validation and applies rate limits.

  2. Idempotency Gate ↗

    Hashes ActorScope and stream SHA-256 and caches non-secret Inspect and DryRun replies.

  3. OWASP Validator ↗

    Throws SpreadsheetValidationException on .xls, macros, XXE, external .rels, or ZIP bombs.

  4. Resilient Blob ↗

    Catches cloud auth or socket errors in Development, logs once, and switches to LocalBlobStorage.

  5. Local FileHost ↗

    Preserves staging/{tenantId}/ sub-paths while blocking rooted or .. traversal paths.

Before this fix, .env Storage__Provider=S3 overrode appsettings.json while Path.GetFileName flattened tenant folders in LocalBlobStorage.1

How do OWASP spreadsheet checks, ambient worker context, and artifact FLS block data leaks?

Diagram structure
  • Incoming File up_file
  • Safe PK, ZIP & XML? owasp_chk
  • 422 InvalidFile reject_422
  • Formula & Raw Redact csv_guard
  • Ambient Actor Scope amb_ctx
  • Clear for FLS & cf? fls_gate
  • Stream Artifact allow_dl
  • 403 Forbidden deny_403
  • amb_ctx → fls_gate · download
  • csv_guard → amb_ctx · stage job
  • fls_gate → allow_dl · yes
  • fls_gate → deny_403 · no
  • owasp_chk → csv_guard · yes
  • owasp_chk → reject_422 · no
  • up_file → owasp_chk
  1. Safe PK, ZIP & XML? ↗

    Rejects OLE2 .xls bytes, 100 MB ZIP bombs, DTDs, vbaProject.bin, ActiveX, and external .rels.

  2. 422 InvalidFile ↗

    Throws SpreadsheetValidationException so hostile or corrupt files return 422 without 500 leaks.

  3. Formula & Raw Redact ↗

    Strips UnicodeCategory.Format chars before prefix checks and redacts restricted raw cells.

  4. Ambient Actor Scope ↗

    Overrides _permissionCache in workers with snapshot IsMembershipContext, RestrictedFields, and EffectivePermissions.

  5. Clear for FLS & cf? ↗

    Fails closed when ActorSnapshotJson is null and blocks unauthorized FLS or cf:* downloads with 403.

Narrowing IsFileParseException to SpreadsheetValidationException ensures database or driver InvalidOperationException strings never leak into DataTransferJob.ErrorSummary.2

How do all 10 module providers, quota ledgers, and Frontend Studio/Portal surfaces stay synchronized?

Diagram structure
  • Studio Overlay & Dock studio_ui
  • Admin Transfer Hub admin_hub
  • Scoped Repository & Store fe_repo
  • DataExchangeOrchestrator dx_orch
  • CustomField Batch Bridge cf_bridge
  • QuotaCounter & Usage quota_svc
  • 5 CRM Providers crm_prov
  • 3 Party Providers party_prov
  • 2 Identity Providers id_prov
  • studio_ui → fe_repo · MVVM hooks
  • admin_hub → fe_repo · TenantRequired
  • fe_repo → dx_orch · REST + Blob
  • dx_orch → cf_bridge · ValidateRef
  • dx_orch → quota_svc · Lease & Bill
  • dx_orch → crm_prov · Batch Lookup
  • dx_orch → party_prov · 3-Sheet DAG
  • dx_orch → id_prov · Scoped Roles
  1. Scoped Repository & Store ↗

    Keys descriptor caches and sessionStorage job docks by userId + tenantId and clears on switch.

  2. DataExchangeOrchestrator ↗

    Runs topological DAG dry-runs, bills WasCreated quota slots before post-commit skips, and re-orders keyset cursors.

  3. CustomField Batch Bridge ↗

    Calls IReferenceValidatingValueTypeHandler.ValidateReferenceAsync during ValidateBatchAsync before entity writes.

  4. 5 CRM Providers ↗

    Resolves crm.account and crm.contact via ResolvePartyIdsBatchAsync without .Take(2000) caps.

  5. 3 Party Providers ↗

    Supports composite keys on party.contact-point, polymorphic parent lookups, and PartyTenantUsageStore sync.

  6. 2 Identity Providers ↗

    Validates blank emails under throttled invites, sets PasswordLastChanged, and isolates SMTP errors.

Replacing uncompiled Tailwind v3 slash-opacity utilities (bg-warning/10, border-nx-accent/40) with semantic HSL and color-mix(...) tokens restores crisp Dark, Light, and RTL rendering across all Studio and Hub views.4
